info.title: ECHO (hand-authored) - Clean Water Act Violation Tracker Rest Services
info.description: HAND-AUTHORED, not an EPA-published schema. Written 2026-11-02 from the behavior of the live service and from how the echo.epa.gov front end calls it. Only parameters that were exercised against the live service are listed; the service may accept or ignore others, and it can change without notice. Service cwa_viotrack_services on the public /echo path. Honored filters found by probing: p_st, p_ptype, p_maj, p_ico. Filters of the documented CWA facility search such as p_zip, p_co, p_act, p_fips, p_reg, p_pid, p_fn and p_naics did not change the result when probed.

get.description: Runs a search and returns a QueryID and row count (QueryRows). Use get_qid to page through results or get_download for CSV. Searches that would return too many rows return an error asking for more selective parameters.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output format. JSON (default), JSONP, or XML.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback. Name of the function in which to wrap the JSON response; used only with output=JSONP.

parameters.name: p_st
parameters.description: Facility state or state-equivalent (USPS abbreviation, e.g. RI). Without a narrowing filter such as this, searches usually exceed the row limit.

parameters.name: p_ptype
parameters.description: Permit type code, e.g. NPD (NPDES individual permit). Same codes as the CWA facility search.

parameters.name: p_maj
parameters.description: Major designation. The service reports the allowed values as none, 'M', 'N'.

parameters.name: p_ico
parameters.description: Indian Country flag. Y or N.
